Requests go straight from this phone to the provider. Keys and sign-ins are encrypted with a key held in Android\'s secure hardware. Open a provider to make it the default. Providers the agent drafted are never used until you review and approve them.

When a chat\'s model is out of quota, its key is refused, or it stays busy after a few retries, Locus asks the next model here instead, for the rest of that turn. A reply never mixes two models, and the reply notes which one answered. Switching to another provider starts its prompt cache from zero, so that first reply costs more.

Models marked Tools can read files, search and act. Chat only models just reply: their chat template has no tools, or they have under 1 billion parameters, too few to use tools reliably. New chats on them start without tools, and Locus warns before giving them a task that needs tools.
